mapper.insert: INSERT INTO draw_record (record_id, user_id, activity_id, strategy_id, award_id, award_name, award_desc, award_type, level, inv_id, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{recordId}, #{userId}, #{activityId}, #{strategyId}, #{awardId}, #{awardName}, #{awardDesc}, #{awardType}, #{level}, #{invId}, #{state}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, record_id, user_id, activity_id, strategy_id, award_id, award_name, award_desc, award_type, level, inv_id, state, create_time, update_time FROM draw_record WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draw_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draw_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND award_type != 'THANKS'

SELECT r.record_id AS recordId, r.award_id AS awardId, r.award_name AS awardName, r.award_type AS awardType, r.level AS level, r.inv_id AS invId, r.create_time AS createTime FROM draw_record r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.award_type != 'THANKS' ORDER BY r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM draw_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND award_type != 'THANKS'
AND state IN #{s}
